description: EMBOSS 6.6.0 prosextract: for every PATTERN entry of prosite.dat (the text of the SIB file) the file PROSITE/prosite.lines (returned as the text) holds the identifier, the accession, the first word of the description, the pattern and its regular expression; for every {PSnnnnn; NAME} entry of prosite.doc one documentation file PROSITE/PSnnnnn (returned in files, by the path of the data directory /usr/share/EMBOSS/data/PROSITE/PSnnnnn) holds the text between {BEGIN} and {END}. Equals the installed program on 300 runs (every input format of seqret, ranges, the report options, the messages of the library; standard output, error stream, exit status and written files byte for byte). B09 WP67, F306.

prositeDat.description: The text of the PROSITE data file prosite.dat (ftp.expasy.org/databases/prosite).

prositeDoc.description: The text of the PROSITE documentation file prosite.doc.

files.description: More files by name (file name -> text) that the program may read (a file named by a USA, @file, the PROSITE data files of the data directory).

text.description: The text of the main output of the program (the report, or its standard output).

files.description: The other files the program wrote (sequences, features, graph data), by name.

messages.description: What the library printed on the error stream (warnings and errors).

errors.message: The program died: the messages of the library (a value it refuses, an input no reader reads, a sequence of the wrong kind)
An input on which the reference program never stops or dies by a fault is refused
